lead.title: FCC Opens 450 MHz to Drone C2, Clears 24 GHz Band for Counter-Drone Radar
lead.summary: The Federal Communications Commission adopted final rules on November 19 that open the 450 MHz band for drone command-and-control links and clear the 24 GHz band for ground-based radar to detect unauthorized drones. The order also updates power rules in the 800 MHz air-ground band to improve in-flight broadband services.

The order also updates power rules in the 800 MHz air-ground band to improve in-flight broadband services.

leads.title: Motional prepares for Uber robotaxi launch in Las Vegas
leads.summary: Motional plans to begin offering fully driverless rides through Uber in Las Vegas in early December, after spending two years overhauling its autonomous driving technology. The company will keep its initial fleet small while it waits for a next-generation platform with less expensive sensors and computing hardware.

leads.title: Army Advances STAMPEDE Drone Manufacturing Initiative
leads.summary: The US Army Contracting Command is coordinating contract awards for the assembly of 400 drone systems and 20 ground control systems to support the Drone Dominance Gauntlet scheduled for March 2027. The STAMPEDE initiative includes a contractual option to purchase up to 10,000 aircraft, which does not represent a confirmed purchase.

stories.title: Volvo Cars begins training Hexagon humanoid robots for factory work
stories.summary: Volvo Cars began training Hexagon Robotics’ AEON humanoid robots at its Ghent, Belgium plant, targeting production integration by mid-2027. The wheeled robots, which stand 1.65 meters tall and carry up to 10 kilograms, are learning precise component placement to handle physically demanding tasks alongside existing automation.

stories.title: UK Eyes Ground-Based Role for DragonFire Laser Weapon After Counter-Drone Naval Trials
stories.summary: Defense minister Luke Pollard confirmed in a November 23, 2026, written answer that the British Ministry of Defense is examining potential DragonFire applications on land after Royal Navy trials showed it can shoot down high-speed drones. The ministry awarded MBDA UK a £316 million contract in November 2025 to deliver DragonFire systems from 2027, with the first installation on a Type 45 destroyer on track for 2027.

stories.title: Quantum Systems sets 727 km/h speed record with counter-UAS demonstrator
stories.summary: Quantum Systems recorded a 727 km/h two-way speed for its Apex Recordhunter counter-unmanned aerial system demonstrator at a German military base on 26 November 2026. The company stated the flight followed an October attempt reaching 777 km/h and that the program informs future high-speed interceptors.

stories.title: Benghazi drone strike exposes deep mistrust stalling Libya's unity
stories.summary: Ukrainian sea drones struck the Russian missile corvette Merkury at Benghazi naval base on Sunday, killing two Libyan naval personnel and causing the ship to capsize. The eastern House of Representatives subsequently launched an initiative to unify institutions and prepare for elections, inviting Tripoli's High Council of State to form a joint committee within a week.

stories.title: Three-Minute Drone Delivery Of Life-Saving Defibrillators Pushes U.S. Emergency Services To Rethink First
stories.summary: The United States is testing pilot programs that authorize drones to transport defibrillators, medicines, and blood to emergency scenes. These initiatives aim to compress response times in rural and congested urban areas where traditional emergency response frequently exceeds the critical window for survival.

stories.title: ROBOTERA Puts 45 Humanoid Robots into Large-Scale Fleet Operations at China Post
stories.summary: China Post's Hangzhou Postal District Center deployed 45 ROBOTERA humanoid robots for parcel induction operations, marking the largest-scale robot testing deployment in comparable postal operations nationwide. The robots increased efficiency from 500–600 to approximately 1,200 parcels per hour while maintaining over 90% operational accuracy.

stories.title: Aeromagija Unveils Hybrid Light Aircraft Designed for Rapid Personal Air Travel
China's new 8-tonne cargo drone: Why it could change the way wars are fought
stories.summary: Chinese aviation company Air White Whale unveiled the W8000, a twin-turboprop cargo drone designed to carry up to eight metric tonnes, in Zhuhai ahead of the China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition scheduled to open on December 7. The aircraft features a rear loading ramp for bulky equipment, though its proposed payload capacity remains a developmental concept that has not yet been demonstrated in flight.

stories.title: Gulf air-taxi services could start in UAE next year, but charging, airspace and fares will decide viability
stories.summary: Joby Aviation completed Florida's second Future of Flight Series test flight on November 4, 2026, marking the first use of Orlando International's Vertipad, which FDOT calls the first on-site at a U.S. commercial airport.

stories.title: Sky ICT Plans Two-Seat Autonomous Air Taxis in Phuket, With 2027 Launch Dependent on Approvals
stories.summary: Thai technology company Sky ICT is preparing an autonomous electric air-taxi service in Phuket, with a possible commercial launch in 2027 that depends on regulations, aircraft certification and approval from the Ministry of Transport. Each eVTOL aircraft would carry two passengers and fly without a pilot on board.

stories.title: NIOA receives AUD 15 million for Australian drone and counter-drone manufacturing expansion
stories.summary: NIOA secured up to AUD 15 million in Queensland Government funding to expand its Maryborough manufacturing facility, contributing to a project with an estimated total cost of AUD 30 million. The company expects the expanded facility to be operational by late 2028, creating and sustaining up to 18 jobs.

stories.title: Mulk International unveils next-generation robotic construction factory powered by Uniqube OS
Austin Light Rail tests soil and rock ahead of expected 2027 or 2028 start
stories.summary: Austin Transit Partnership crews sampled soil and rock at about 100 locations along the planned route, with construction expected in late 2027 or early 2028. The 9.8-mile Phase 1 project has a total capital cost of $8,234.0 million and seeks a $4,067.0 million Federal Transit Administration grant, estimated for summer 2027.

stories.title: From soldiers to robots: Former IDF general takes leadership role at AITAN
Drone Package Delivery Market to Reach USD 22.06 Billion by 2035 as Zipline Secures USD 1.5 Billion to Build N
stories.summary: Zipline announced a USD 1.5 billion funding round on November 5, 2026, at a USD 21.5 billion valuation to support U.S. manufacturing expansion and a nationwide drone delivery network. The company also signed a multi-year agreement with Walmart to establish 300 additional drone delivery sites across the United States.

stories.title: Poland outlines high-speed rail network with lines designed for 350 km/h operation
stories.summary: Poland outlined a high-speed rail network under the Port Polska programme, with the Y Line's Warsaw-Łódź section scheduled to open in 2032 and extensions to Poznań and Wrocław expected by 2035. The infrastructure is designed for 350 km/h operation, while other corridors are planned for 250 km/h speeds.

stories.title: Fraught Coradia Max rolling stock programme pushes Alstom deep into the red
stories.summary: Alstom reported a €954m first-half loss due to major delays to its Coradia Max programme for Germany. The company is preparing to sell businesses and raise fresh money to cut its debt by €2bn.

stories.title: Geotechnical technology for high-speed rail will be a focal point at Geotec Hanoi 2026.
stories.summary: Minh Duc EC and Strata Geosystems introduced geotechnical solutions for soil reinforcement and railway structure stabilization at Geotec Hanoi 2026, scheduled for November 26-27, 2026, at the National Convention Center in Hanoi.

stories.title: Drones set key Russian oil hub on fire – video, photos
stories.summary: A drone crashed at the Subkhankulovo line production dispatch station in Bashkortostan, starting a fire at a major hub in Transneft's trunk oil pipeline system. Bulat Musin, Head of the Tuymazy district administration, confirmed no fatalities or injuries, while emergency services worked at the scene. The extent of the damage is unknown, and there is no confirmed data on a halt to oil pumping.

stories.title: Japan takes delivery of AI-guided interceptor drones
stories.summary: Japan has taken delivery of its first batch of Terra B1 interceptor drones, about three months after signing a mass-production contract, according to Tokyo-based maker Terra Drone. The company said it had built a domestic production line for the drone and completed delivery to Japan’s Acquisition, Technology and Logistics Agency (ATLA), the defense ministry’s procurement arm.

stories.title: Xpeng Executive Says Home Humanoid Robots Could Follow Commercial Deployment by One to Two Years
stories.summary: Xpeng co-president Brian Gu said the company plans to begin mass-producing its Iron robot in January 2027, with sales targeted for the second quarter and deliveries later in the year. Gu stated that home humanoid robots could follow successful commercial deployment by one to two years.

stories.title: Physical AI at work: inside our robotics area at electronica 2026
China to Unveil Mobile Counter-Drone Defense System
stories.summary: China North Industries Group (NORINCO) will unveil a new mobile counter-drone defense system at an airshow in Guangdong Province from December 7 to 13. The truck-mounted platform features 24 launch cells for short-range interception and has drawn comparisons to Israel's Iron Dome.

stories.title: Swarm Drones Fly in Perfect Formation Without GPS...DDE Showcases Its Capabilities at NATO Procurement Agency
stories.summary: Data Design Engineering (DDE) demonstrated autonomous swarm drone technology operating without Global Positioning System (GPS) reception at the Autonomous & AI Summit 2026, hosted by the NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA) in Luxembourg on the 24th. The company, which expanded into Luxembourg in 2022, stated it will expand technological and business cooperation with European defense institutions using Luxembourg as its base.

stories.title: Latvia showcases four new homegrown naval drones at its Independence Day parade
stories.summary: Latvia unveiled four new naval drones built by NEWT21 during its Independence Day parade on November 18. The two FOG boats and two RAY catamarans, which have been in mass production since August, were previously tested in Ukraine.

stories.title: Drone Marketplace: How Canada Adapts Ukraine's Brave1 Approach
stories.summary: Canada launched its drone marketplace in July 2026, modeled on Ukraine’s Brave1 approach, and has already awarded 12 contracts. The Department of National Defence and Defence Investment Agency are developing four integrated portals to connect military users with industry, simplifying the path from identifying a requirement to acquiring a capability.

stories.title: PODCAST: Al Thuraya Holdings’ Michael Padilla on where cybersecurity meets flight safety
Boom Supersonic's Sprint Core Engine Prototype Reaches 6,500 RPM in Pivotal Test
stories.summary: Boom Supersonic successfully tested its Sprint Core engine prototype to 6,500 RPM east of Denver, using nearly 2,000 sensors to monitor performance. The company plans to conduct full engine testing by mid-2027, with the engine initially powering 42-megawatt gas turbines for AI data centers before adapting to its Symphony supersonic airliner.

stories.title: Kuwait buys £370 million in counter-drone defences. What will the British contract change?
stories.summary: On 9 October, the British Ministry of Defence announced a £370 million contract for MARSS to supply and integrate radars, jammers, and interceptors with its NiDAR command and control platform. EOS refers to 2027 in its announcement but gives no single date for all elements to reach operational readiness.

stories.title: IIT Patna graduates who worked at Amazon and Google raise Rs 22.36 crore for their Bengaluru robotics startup
stories.summary: Kiran Mathew Koshy and Delip Thomas raised Rs 22.36 crore for their Bengaluru-based startup Cosine Robots, led by Avaana Capital with participation from WEH Ventures and other angel investors. The company plans to use the funds to establish a dedicated research and production facility in Bengaluru, expand its engineering team, and increase the manufacturing of integrated servo actuators for industrial and humanoid robots.

stories.title: 30+ explosions rock Stavropol Krai as drones strike power station near Nevinnomyssk Azot
stories.summary: Drones struck the Nevinnomyssk Thermal Power Plant in Russia's Stavropol Krai overnight, hitting a 410-megawatt unit that powers a key explosives-component plant, Russian outlet Astra reported on Nov. 26. Local residents reported hearing more than 30 explosions alongside heavy air defense fire, while Stavropol Krai Governor Vladimir Vladimirov warned of an ongoing drone threat targeting Nevinnomyssk’s industrial zone.

stories.title: Russian drones and missiles that strike Ukraine still have Western components
stories.summary: Ukrainian authorities identified more than 16,000 foreign-made components in Russian weapons since February 2022, including parts from Texas Instruments and STMicroelectronics found in Geran-4 drones. The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project reported that Russia continues to access Western technology despite sanctions, with components manufactured as recently as February 2026 appearing in intercepted devices.

stories.title: Driverless tram testing expands in Yekaterinburg
stories.summary: Legal changes in Russia permit the testing of a driverless tram in real-world conditions on the interurban tramway linking Yekaterinburg with neighbouring Verkhnyaya Pyshma.

stories.title: Zoomlion Launches Industry’s First AI Excavation Robot Powered by Embodied Intelligence at bauma CHINA 2026
stories.summary: Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science & Technology Co., Ltd. launched the industry’s first AI excavation robot powered by embodied intelligence at bauma CHINA 2026 on Nov. 24. The equipment features voice interaction, environmental perception, and autonomous operation capabilities, including centimeter-level placement accuracy for tasks like wall building and pipe alignment.

stories.title: £1.7m drone detection trial announced after football delay
stories.summary: The Government announced a £1.7 million trial of drone-detection technology to be tested by police in London. The Department for Transport said the £1.2 million trial will improve police monitoring of drone activity, while a further £500,000 from the Regulatory Innovation Office will fund additional equipment and infrastructure to support commercial drone services.

also.title: New digital number plates to help police crackdown on criminal drone use

stories.title: Hellmann, Exotec deploy robotics at Siemens warehouse
stories.summary: Hellmann Worldwide Logistics is partnering with Exotec to automate intralogistics operations at Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings’ Nuremberg site, with a robotic warehouse system scheduled to go live in mid-2027. The project will deploy Exotec’s Skypod system to automate storage, order fulfilment and material movement, increasing warehouse capacity and improving efficiency, quality and space utilisation as volumes grow.

also.title: Hellmann and Exotec to introduce robotic warehouse system at Siemens site

stories.title: The Fierce Competition of Chinese Autonomous Taxis in Dubai: Market Expansion, Tech Advantages & Global Layout
stories.summary: Uber plans to invest approximately 50 million US dollars in the next two years to expand autonomous driving services and operation facilities in Dubai. The company aims to increase vehicle numbers and upgrade services to include on-demand door-to-door ride-hailing within designated zones, covering Downtown Dubai, the Dubai International Financial Centre, and Business Bay.

stories.title: NHTSA Publishes Proposed Rule on Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards for Automatic Emergency Braking
Aerpace Industries Proposes Merging Aerpace Robotics To Integrate Unmanned Systems Operations
stories.summary: Aerpace Industries proposed merging Aerpace Robotics to unify research, manufacturing, and unmanned aerial systems operations under a single corporate entity. The company aims to streamline technology development and reduce inter-company transaction friction, with detailed swap ratios and regulatory approvals remaining pending.

stories.title: Administration Pushes $5 Billion in Transit Grants to 2028
Universal Robots Integrates Inbolt 3D AI Vision Software Into Gen 7 Platform
stories.summary: Universal Robots integrated Inbolt’s 3D AI vision software into its Gen 7 platform, enabling vision processing directly on the robot controller without an external industrial PC. Announced at SPS in Nuremberg, the system uses a wrist-mounted 3D camera to identify parts via CAD data and adjust the robot’s path, supporting applications like screwdriving and machine tending.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor to Begin Supplying Robotaxis to Waymo Starting in the Fourth Quarter
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor will begin supplying Ioniq 5 vehicles dedicated to autonomous driving to Waymo starting in the fourth quarter of 2026. The vehicles, produced at the Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America in Georgia, U.S., are intended to support Waymo's international business expansion starting in early 2027.

stories.title: World-Leading Computing, AI and Robotics Technologies Converge at China
stories.summary: The 28th China Hi-Tech Fair will take place from November 26 to 28, 2026, at the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center in Bao’an. The event will bring together world-leading computing, artificial intelligence and robotics technologies, with 10,000 overseas buyers gathering in Shenzhen.

stories.title: U.S. Aviation Leaders Link Airspace Modernization to Resilience, Safety and New Aircraft at Washington Summit
stories.summary: The second annual American Aviation Leadership Summit convened in Washington, D.C., shortly after a nationwide ground stop disrupted air travel. More than 60 U.S. aviation organizations urged Congress to add at least $30 billion for air traffic control modernization in a Monday letter.

stories.title: Neural Network Surrogate Predicts Autonomous Fleet Availability and Boosts
stories.summary: Researchers published a study in Discover Artificial Intelligence demonstrating that a backpropagation neural network surrogate accurately models autonomous vehicle availability and raises modeled operating profit by 17.0 percent. The framework improved predictive accuracy by 48.5 percent over conventional analytical benchmarks under degradation-dependent cascading failure rates.

stories.title: Samsung, SK Hynix to develop international standards for semiconductor robots, deploy 10,000 by 2030
San Francisco Waymo passenger finds loaded gun in robotaxi
stories.summary: A San Francisco passenger found a loaded Colt .25 handgun in a Waymo robotaxi on Nov. 17. Waymo reviewed trip data to identify the account holder associated with the terms of service violation and took appropriate action.

also.title: Waymo Says It’s Reviewing Customer Service After Passenger Finds Loaded Gun in Robotaxi

stories.title: Indrotek, Robotics, UAV and Counter-UAS Solutions, Files for U.S. National Exchange IPO
stories.summary: Indrocorp Technologies Inc., doing business as Indrotek, filed a Form F-1 to register its initial U.S. public offering of common shares. The company has not disclosed the number of shares, price range, or expected offering proceeds in this preliminary filing.

stories.title: FEV hosts Advanced Robotics Conference on robot deployment
stories.summary: FEV will host the Advanced Robotics Conference on 25–26 November at its headquarters in Aachen, Germany, to discuss industrial deployment, safety, and AI learning. The event features live robot demonstrations, a Hugging Face presentation on LeRobot, and a panel with Schaeffler, RoboStrategy, Fraunhofer IPA, and MYBOTSHOP examining Europe's competitive position in humanoid robotics.

stories.title: Ford Ranger becomes rail vehicle with factory approval, running on tracks and roads with hydraulically lowered steel wheels, a 600-Nm diesel V6 and 4,500-kg towing capacity
stories.summary: Aries Rail unveiled a Ford Ranger Super Duty rail vehicle on Nov. 23, 2026, featuring hydraulically lowered steel wheels and a 600-Nm diesel V6. The first production unit will display at the AusRAIL 2026 exhibition in Brisbane from Nov. 23 to 25.

stories.title: Press Release: Quigley, Duckworth and Durbin Respond to FRA Chicago Amtrak Facility Grant Rescoping
Drone Threats Prompt RAF To Install Netting At Bases To Protect Aircraft: Reports
stories.summary: The Royal Air Force is installing Kevlar anti-drone nets to protect aircraft that cannot be placed in hangars or hardened shelters, according to reports from The Times and Sky News. The British Defense Ministry stated it is investing an additional £470 million to strengthen security at military sites, including better physical protection and counter-drone capabilities.

stories.title: MBTA Revisits Its Long-Term Vision for Regional Rail
stories.summary: The MBTA is revisiting its $40.7 billion 2019 “rail vision” plans for the commuter rail system to reflect new post-pandemic and economic realities. In a series of public meetings on November 4th and 17th, the T kicked off its new Regional Rail Modernization planning initiative.

stories.title: FAA expects few near-term changes for helicopters sharing low-altitude airspace
stories.summary: The FAA told Vertical Plus that helicopter operators should expect few changes to day-to-day airspace procedures over the next 12 to 24 months as drone operations expand and piloted eVTOL aircraft prepare to enter service. The agency stated that early piloted eVTOL flights will use established helicopter routes and follow existing visual flight rules and air traffic control procedures.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Spotted in Anaheim Hills, California
stories.summary: A gold Tesla Cybercab appeared in Anaheim Hills, California, on November 24, days after the company began offering rides in Dallas. Local resident Steven Silwanis shared video of the two-seater, noting it was his first time seeing one outside Texas, though the clip does not confirm autonomous driving.

also.title: Tesla Cybercab Robotaxis Spotted in Phoenix

stories.title: Angelini Technologies acquires stake in Oversonic Robotics to support international expansion
stories.summary: Angelini Technologies acquired a stake in Oversonic Robotics to support the Italian company's industrial growth and international expansion, with a particular focus on the US market. The investment follows the addition of STMicroelectronics, Fondazione Tech e Biomedical, and SpotInvest to Oversonic's shareholder base in June 2026, while financial terms and the size of the stake were not disclosed.

stories.title: US Marines debut 10 Archer attack drones for first time in seven-month rotation
stories.summary: The Marine Rotational Force-Darwin deployed 10 Archer first-person-view strike drones and the Tactical Resupply Unmanned Aircraft System to Australia for the first time during its seven-month rotation. Around 2,000 Marines served on the deployment, which included training in New Caledonia, French Polynesia, the Philippines, and Papua New Guinea.

stories.title: 3D-printed robotic hand cuts complexity without sacrificing dexterity
stories.summary: Associate professor Cong Wang and doctoral student Neel Adwani designed the PHD Hand, a 3D-printed robotic hand that uses off-the-shelf servos and springs to reduce cost and maintenance compared to commercial options. The team released files, videos, and complete instructions on the project website, with future work focused on manipulating real-world objects and integrating tactile sensing.

stories.title: JATEC Project Targets 3D Printing for Drone Repair and Component Supply
stories.summary: The NATO-Ukraine Joint Analysis, Training and Education Centre (JATEC) is running a project to develop additive manufacturing systems for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to support rapid repair and component supply. The initiative aims to apply Ukraine’s battlefield experience to defense capabilities developed with NATO partners, including training specialists and building an expert community for practical military solutions.

stories.title: Meta-Learning and Physics Model Accurately Predicts Ducted eVTOL Ground
stories.summary: A research team developed a physics-inspired data-driven model that predicts transient, non-linear in-ground-effect thrust fluctuations in ducted-fan electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft. Experimental evaluations revealed the model achieved mean relative errors of 1.1 percent on training tasks and 0.7 percent on testing tasks.

stories.title: Tesla Expands Robotaxi in Dallas and Cuts Fares
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Dallas Robotaxi service area north of University Park toward Farmers Branch, Addison, and Richardson on November 25, adding more cars and lowering fares ahead of Thanksgiving. The company did not specify the new flat fare or the duration of the lower pricing.

also.title: Tesla nearly doubles Dallas Robotaxi coverage just one week after Cybercab launch

stories.title: Transit Unplugged Down Under: From driverless trains to century-old steamships
stories.summary: Sydney Metro opened its Southwest Metro extension on Oct. 30, converting a roughly 130-year-old railway corridor into a fully automated network spanning approximately 66 kilometers. The new line connects Sydney's northwest, central business district, and southwest, with trains operating as frequently as every four minutes during peak periods.

stories.title: EU proposes adding one of Russia’s smallest drone manufacturers to its 22nd sanctions package
stories.summary: The EU proposed adding Ural-based drone maker Vertikal and its director Janis Steinbergs to the 22nd sanctions package. The draft also includes Rosatom enterprises, International Boxing Association president Umar Kremlev, and First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov.

stories.title: Britain abandons laser anti-drone contest for now over flaws
stories.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence abandoned the Project PANOPTES laser anti-drone procurement on 24 November, citing unacceptable risks from flawed Stage 1 evaluation criteria. The department intends to return to the market with a revised procurement in the near future, after originally planning contracts of up to six months to start in February 2027.

stories.title: No Starlink, no problem, part deux: Ukrainian student invents autopilot system for UAV that works without GPS, receives "The future of Ukraine" presidential award
stories.summary: Yaroslav Sheiko, an 11th-grade pupil from Poltava, received the presidential distinction known as "The Future of Ukraine" for his engineering achievements. His work includes an artificial intelligence-powered flight control system and optical-electronic stabilization technology designed for unmanned aerial vehicles.

stories.title: Tesla Plans Steering-Wheel-Free Model Y for Larger Robotaxi Groups
stories.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company is considering a driverless Model Y without a steering wheel or pedals to transport six or seven people, as the current two-seater Cybercab serves most passenger trips. Musk did not provide a launch date, pricing, or details on how the vehicle would meet requirements for operation without conventional driver controls.

also.title: Tesla to Equip Model Y With Starlink for Robotaxi Service

stories.title: Joby Aviation Jumps 9% as Air Taxi Stocks Defy Tech Selloff; Archer Aviation Rallies 7%, EHang Rises 6%
stories.summary: Joby Aviation stock rose 9% to $3.83 on November 25, outpacing Archer Aviation and EHang as technology shares sold off. The company previously raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $135 million to $140 million and reported a Q3 per-share loss of $0.22, beating expectations.

stories.title: Will Poland buy counter-drone lasers? A deal could be reached within a few months
stories.summary: Polish Defence Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz said an agreement to acquire counter-drone lasers could be signed within the next few months. The Armament Agency plans preliminary market consultations for two directed-energy systems, one engaging targets at least one kilometre away and the other at no less than 3 km.

stories.title: CLOBOT Unveils Boston Dynamics Spot Live Demo Room in South Korea, Expands Industrial Robotics Business
stories.summary: CLOBOT Co. unveiled a Spot Live Demo Room in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, on November 25, showcasing the Boston Dynamics robot performing nine autonomous industrial inspection tasks in approximately seven minutes. The facility replicates real-world environments to demonstrate predictive maintenance capabilities using thermal imaging, acoustic imaging, and AI-powered visual inspection.

stories.title: Pentagon Budgets Up to $500 Million for Extended Range Drone Strike Program
stories.summary: The Defense Innovation Unit opened a solicitation for the Extended Range Strike Gauntlet II program, budgeting up to $500 million for prizes and development. The competition is open to domestic and international companies, with demonstrations planned for March 2027 and a third round in August 2027.

stories.title: New UK Defense Trade Group Aims to Accelerate Adoption of Autonomous Systems
stories.summary: Autonomous UK launched on November 25 with 16 founding members to speed the adoption of autonomous systems across the United Kingdom. The organization, which includes Delta Quad and Saronic, outlined five priorities: funding, procurement, testing, certification, and scaling production.

also.title: DeltaQuad Joins Autonomous UK, New Defense Autonomy Trade Body
DeltaQuad joins Autonomous UK as founding member

stories.title: ARX Robotics says GEREON is first ground robot to join British Army targeting network
stories.summary: ARX Robotics said its GEREON became the first ground robot to connect to the British Army’s AI-enabled targeting network during Exercise Haraka Storm in Kenya. The German company said the Army took a tenth as long to detect a target, decide how to respond and act during the trial.

stories.title: FCC Opens 450 MHz to Drone C2, Clears 24 GHz Band for Counter-Drone Radar
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission adopted final rules on November 19 that open the 450 MHz band for drone command-and-control links and clear the 24 GHz band for ground-based radar to detect unauthorized drones. The order also updates power rules in the 800 MHz air-ground band to improve in-flight broadband services.

stories.title: Building Together: A New Model for U.S. Defense Drone Manufacturing
stories.summary: XMX Defense announced that seven companies committed to the Texas Unmanned Systems Defense Center of Excellence at Mineral Wells Regional Airport, with four others in discussions. The privately led initiative offers shared testing infrastructure, manufacturing capabilities, and workforce development to accelerate defense technology production.

stories.title: Russian deputy PM says protecting utilities from Ukrainian drones is a top priority this winter
stories.summary: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin told lawmakers that protecting utility infrastructure from Ukrainian drone attacks is a top priority this winter, noting that some power and heating plants in and around Moscow are now covered with anti-drone nets.

also.title: Russia Prepares Utility Networks for Winter Drone Attacks

stories.title: How Vention is cutting factory programming from weeks to minutes
Humble Robotics Raises $51 Million for Cabless Trucks
stories.summary: Humble Robotics raised $51 million, bringing its total funding to $75 million, to develop the Humble Hauler, a cabless Class 8 autonomous truck. The San Francisco startup plans initial customer pilots for 2027 and broader scaling for 2028, targeting short routes between ports, factories, and warehouses.

stories.title: IITs to add 6,000 seats in Robotics, Physical AI and Space Technology over 10 years
stories.summary: The Bhupat and Jyoti Mehta Family Foundation will add 6,000 seats in Robotics, Physical AI, and Space Engineering Technology across multiple IITs over eight to ten years. The initiative includes 5,000 seats for Robotics and Physical AI and 1,000 for Space Engineering, supported by more than 120 dedicated faculty members.

stories.title: Cabinet relaxes drone alert regulations for businesses
stories.summary: The Ukrainian government extended the transition period for businesses to comply with drone threat shelter requirements through June 4, 2027, the Economy Ministry announced on Nov. 25. Businesses that have not yet provided access to shelters may continue operating with employees' consent and while implementing organizational safety measures.

stories.title: Confirmed | This Latin American country is investing $7 billion in its capital's first subway line: It will use Chinese trains, 100% electric and driverless
stories.summary: Colombia is investing nearly $7 billion in Bogota's first subway line, which will use 30 driverless, electric trains made by CRRC. Mayor Carlos Fernando Galan confirmed on Nov. 15, 2026, that the project is 84.68% complete, with commercial service targeted for March 2028.

stories.title: Zelensky reports Ukrainian drone strike on Russian military airfield
stories.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky reported that Ukrainian drones struck a Russian military airfield, with damage still being assessed. He stated that Russian aircraft, military ships, and vessels carrying Russian weapons are legitimate targets for Ukraine.

stories.title: Omni X Emerges From Stealth With AI Built to Protect Cities and Soldiers From Drone Threats
stories.summary: Omni X emerged from stealth on Nov. 25, 2026, announcing its agentic operating system is ready for deployment with defense, government, and public safety clients. The company launched two product lines: IRIS, a counter-drone system for individual soldiers, and a civic platform for cities, airports, seaports, and stadiums.

stories.title: France's Vinci raises stake in Lisea, values high-speed rail operator at â¬2.1 billion
stories.summary: French infrastructure group Vinci raised its stake in Lisea, the operator of the South Europe Atlantic high-speed rail line between Tours and Bordeaux, to 50.04% by buying an additional 8.0% from state-owned Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations. The deal values Lisea's equity at €2.1 billion ($2.30 billion), and Vinci said Lisea would be little affected by any increase in the long-distance infrastructure tax under consideration in France's 2027 finance bill.

stories.title: When One Robot Learns, Can a Thousand Others Follow?
stories.summary: NVIDIA introduced GR00T 2 in November 2026, a model designed to predict future states and control robotic systems using pretraining data that includes more than 400,000 hours of egocentric video. In one experiment, a robot with two five-fingered hands achieved a 65% success rate placing filter paper into a funnel after observing only human demonstrations.

stories.title: Motional prepares for Uber robotaxi launch in Las Vegas
stories.summary: Motional plans to begin offering fully driverless rides through Uber in Las Vegas in early December, after spending two years overhauling its autonomous driving technology. The company will keep its initial fleet small while it waits for a next-generation platform with less expensive sensors and computing hardware.

stories.title: Embention and the Polish Naval Academy (AMW) Sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Unmanned Systems
stories.summary: Embention and the Polish Naval Academy (AMW) signed a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a framework for technical training on Veronte Autopilot, knowledge exchange, and research exploration in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). The agreement creates a direct channel between industry and naval education, with specific lines of work to be defined jointly and subject to separate agreements.

stories.title: Robin Radar supports airspace security at Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix in partnership with LVMPD
stories.summary: Robin Radar Systems partnered with the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department to support counter-unmanned aircraft system operations during the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix. The IRIS counter-drone radar integrated into Dedrone’s command-and-control system at the Southern Nevada Counterterrorism Center, providing real-time situational awareness and 360-degree coverage of the race site. The deployment contributed to a successful security operation with no reported drone incursions or hostile aerial activity disrupting the event.

stories.title: Amazon’s Seven-Minute Shampoo Drone Delivery Ends in a Federal Investigation
stories.summary: The FAA is investigating an Amazon drone that crashed onto a residential garage in Huntington Woods, Michigan, on Nov. 20. The drone struck a fiber-optic cable and power lines during takeoff, and Amazon stated there were no injuries.

stories.title: FCC should focus on robot security, not country of origin
stories.summary: David Pinn, CEO of Brain Corp, argues the FCC should regulate robot security based on software control rather than country of origin. He states that Brain Corp's technology runs more than 50,000 robots on six continents and has logged more than 25 million hours of autonomous operation.

stories.title: US military drone range could increase as special forces test lithium-sulfur batteries
stories.summary: Li-S Energy shipped 10Ah lithium-sulfur power cells to SOFWERX, a Florida-based non-profit innovation hub working with United States Special Operations Command, to test if the lighter batteries can outperform conventional cells in demanding military environments.

stories.title: RAF plans to build anti-drone nets at UK bases as aircraft 'are moved into hardened hangars overnight to keep them safe'
stories.summary: The Royal Air Force is fortifying its bases with anti-drone nets and hardened hangars as part of a £470 million security overhaul. The Ministry of Defence stated it is investing an additional £470 million to strengthen physical protection, surveillance, and counter-drone capabilities at military sites.

stories.summary: BETA Technologies, Surf Air Mobility and Hawaiian Airlines demonstrated the all-electric ALIA aircraft at Daniel K. Inouye International Airport in Honolulu in June to assess interisland cargo service. The aircraft, built in Vermont, carries up to 200 cubic feet of cargo and uses a mobile Mini Cube charging unit while permanent infrastructure develops.

stories.summary: Ukraine shot down a jet-powered 'Geran' drone using the Blysk air defense laser system developed by Carmin Sky. stories.summary: Ukrainian officials reportedly found Nvidia Jetson Orin modules in Russian drones, including one that killed three civilians in Zaporizhzhia on July 6. Snopes left the claim unrated due to a lack of primary evidence from Russia, while Nvidia stated its modules are not available in Russia and are not designed for military purposes.

stories.title: Bedrock Robotics Valued at $4.1 Billion
stories.summary: Bedrock Robotics closed a $600 million Series C round co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, valuing the startup at $4.1 billion. The company sells self-driving kits retrofitted onto excavators and worksite vehicles, with commercial deployments across the United States.

stories.title: Waymo Recalls 4,488 Robotaxis After Closed Freeway Failures
stories.summary: Waymo filed two voluntary recalls covering 4,488 vehicles after its automated-driving system failed to recognize closed freeway lanes. California’s DMV banned driverless freeway operations on November 11, citing an imminent hazard, until Waymo demonstrates its corrective actions address the deficiencies.

stories.title: State pushing for new regulations to promote drone use
stories.summary: The state government is funding new drone programs for package and medical deliveries. The Department of Transportation partnered with the Michigan Economic Development Corp. and the Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity to create the Advanced Air Mobility Activation Fund in 2025.

stories.title: Tesla Stock Drops More Than 5% As EU Delays Self-Driving Vote And SpaceX Merger Talks Rattle Investors
stories.summary: Tesla shares fell 5.18% Wednesday after the European Union postponed its vote on the company's driver-assistance software to Dec. 15. Investors also reacted to reports of merger talks with SpaceX and a broad sell-off in technology stocks.

NS launches second-hand train sales portal as EU closes competition inquiry

EU Drone Wall Due in December as Leak Puts Most Defenses Past 2030
stories.summary: The European Drone Defence Initiative is due to reach initial capacity by the end of December, with full operation expected a year later. A leaked European Defence Agency report indicates that only about a third of member states' counter-drone programs are expected to deliver by the end of the decade, despite €18.9 billion in investment between 2024 and 2029.

stories.title: Royal Navy picks HII for mine hunting drone fleet
stories.summary: Defence Equipment and Support published a notice describing the procurement of eight mine hunting mission systems, including unmanned underwater vehicles, valued at £303 million excluding VAT. The award decision was made on 3 November, with a revised estimated contract start date of Wednesday 25th November 2026.

stories.title: Ukrainian Air3F Unveils T-Bone Digital Ground Control Station for FPV Drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian company Air3F presented the T-Bone Digital, a new digital ground control station for unmanned aerial vehicles that supports high-resolution video transmission. The station is built around the Walksnail Ascent digital video transmission system and consists of an operator’s case with a 19-inch monitor and a remote Viper antenna unit.

stories.title: Türkiye’s Aselsan integrates laser-guided Tolun L munition onto Bayraktar Akinci drone in live-fire test
stories.summary: Turkish defense firm Aselsan successfully integrated its 250-pound-class Tolun L laser-guided munition onto a Bayraktar Akinci drone during a live-fire test. The trial marked the first time the Tolun L had been integrated onto a drone platform, according to the manufacturer.

stories.title: Americans Are Taking the Train in Record Numbers. Is US Rail Ready?
stories.summary: Amtrak recorded 37.1 million passenger trips in the 2026 financial year, a 7.4% increase on the previous year, as demand for rail travel in the US continues to grow. The record comes amid a major programme of fleet replacement and infrastructure investment, which hopes to pave the way for accommodating a larger passenger rail market in the US.

Russia Outbuys Ukraine For Chinese Drone Fiber As Prices Jump Sixfold
stories.summary: Russia outbids Ukraine for Chinese optical fiber as prices jump sixfold to nearly $30 per kilometer, according to a Financial Times report. Russian buyers secure the limited supply through centralized, large-volume direct agreements, while Ukraine’s fragmented purchasing across hundreds of companies leaves it at a disadvantage.

stories.title: Kodiak delivers first Western Star trucks for Atlas Energy’s growing autonomous fleet
stories.summary: Kodiak delivered the first Western Star trucks equipped with its seventh-generation hardware to Atlas Energy Solutions, bringing the company's autonomous fleet to 37 trucks operating in the Permian Basin. The new platform offers 50% more computing power, and Atlas ordered 100 trucks in April 2025 after Kodiak reached specific milestones.

Einride eyes $250M in ’27 revenues, cash flow milestone the year after
stories.summary: Einride executives forecast the company will finish 2027 with annualized revenues of $250 million, up from roughly $90 million in 2026, and break even on a cash flow basis in 2028. The Stockholm-based firm expects its fleet to reach about 800 trucks by the end of next year, with two-thirds of the projected 2027 revenue covered by longer-term contracts.

stories.title: Army Advances STAMPEDE Drone Manufacturing Initiative
stories.summary: The US Army Contracting Command is coordinating contract awards for the assembly of 400 drone systems and 20 ground control systems to support the Drone Dominance Gauntlet scheduled for March 2027. The STAMPEDE initiative includes a contractual option to purchase up to 10,000 aircraft, which does not represent a confirmed purchase.

stories.title: Pentagon Looks to Auto Industry to Scale US Drone Manufacturing
stories.summary: The Pentagon held preliminary discussions with Ford, General Motors, and Magna to expand US drone production by leveraging automotive supply chains for motors and components. Reuters confirmed Ford discussed military vehicles and satellites with the Pentagon, though no agreements have been announced.

stories.summary: Japanese humanoid robotics startup Black AI secured seed funding from Incubate Fund to develop robots and AI systems for manufacturing environments. The Tokyo-based company will use the investment to speed up humanoid development, expand research into general-purpose robot intelligence, and recruit additional personnel.

stories.title: Ericsson demonstrates tactical 5G connectivity for counter-drone systems during Spanish exercise
stories.summary: Ericsson demonstrated tactical 5G connectivity for counter-drone systems during Spain’s ATLAS 26 exercise from 19 to 23 October at the Médano del Loro training area in Huelva. The deployment used Ericsson’s Ultra Compact Core on frequencies reserved exclusively for military use, enabling wireless data exchange between sensors, radars, command posts and effectors without fixed cabling.

stories.summary: Dynamic Aerospace Systems Corporation formally filed three provisional patent applications covering battery arm designs, parachute recovery systems, and cell compression for autonomous drones. The company stated these innovations address flight endurance, reliability, and safety priorities in the commercial UAV sector.

stories.title: Turkish drone maker Skydagger uses AFRIDEX and BAMEX to enter Africa
stories.summary: Turkish unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) manufacturer Skydagger exhibited its kamikaze drones, loitering munitions and interceptor drones at the Africa International Defence Exhibition (AFRIDEX) 2026 in Lagos and the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX) 2026 in Mali. At AFRIDEX, held at Eko Atlantic in Lagos from 26 to 29 October, Skydagger exhibited within the official Türkiye pavilion, organised under the Turkish Presidency of Defence Industries (SSB).

stories.title: Heavy-Lift Drones Deliver Over 55 Tonnes of Solar Panels to Bentley Motors’ Paint Shop in Believed UK First
stories.summary: AutoSpray Systems used heavy-lift drones to deliver over 55 tonnes of solar panels to Bentley Motors’ Paint Shop in Crewe, a UK first for onshore rooftop construction logistics. The operation moved approximately 10 tonnes daily using the XAG P150 Max under a UK Civil Aviation Authority Operational Authorisation.

stories.title: Putnam Sheriff's Draft Drone Policy Puts ICE Behind a Judge's Warrant
stories.summary: Putnam County Sheriff Brian Hess presented a draft Drone as First Responder policy to the Putnam County Legislature’s Protective Services Committee on November 18 in Carmel, New York. The draft states that Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) needs a judge’s warrant to receive drone video, and Hess wants the drones flying by April 2027 at a cost of $1.3 million over five years.

stories.title: Royal Navy to get US-made underwater drones that can hunt sea mines for 110 hours
stories.summary: Britain awarded HII a $186 million contract for REMUS 620 minehunting drones that can operate for 110 hours and dive to 1,968 feet. The deal supports Britain's Hybrid Navy strategy, combining crewed ships with autonomous systems.

stories.title: SCARA Robot Market: Why Electronics And Automotive Makers Are Turning To Fast, Compact Automation
stories.summary: The SCARA Robot Market value stood at USD 11.00 billion in 2025 and is anticipated to grow to USD 27.26 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 9.50% in the forecast period of 2026-2035. Four-axis robots held around 64.60% of the market by axis count, while the electronics and semiconductor industry accounted for 40.10% of total demand in 2025.

stories.summary: Embention announced Veronte Autopilot 4x 2.2, a triple-redundant flight control computer for defense drones, civil drones, and eVTOL, available for order now. Minister confirms progress on carrier drone wingman trials
stories.summary: Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry Luke Pollard confirmed that Northrop Grumman’s TALON demonstrator will prepare for trials next year in UK waters, including launching from a Queen Elizabeth Class aircraft carrier. The First Sea Lord announced the plan at the International Sea Power Conference on 10 November 2026, stating he would sign a statement of intent with Northrop Grumman aboard HMS Prince of Wales.

stories.title: Council Committee Backs Permanent Police Drone Program After Seven-Week Pilot
stories.summary: A City Council committee on Wednesday, Nov. 18, backed a plan to launch a permanent police drone program and open a center to monitor live camera feeds, following a seven-week pilot in which drones were first on scene about 83% of the time. The plan still needs City Council approval and about $2 million in additional funding.

stories.title: XPENG Unveils Turing Physical AI Architecture and IRON Robot
stories.summary: XPENG Inc. unveiled its Turing Physical AI Architecture and IRON humanoid robot at its eighth AI Day in Guangzhou, China, on November 25, 2026. The company stated that IRON will begin training as a store assistant in Q1 2027, with an official public release targeted for Q2 2027.

stories.summary: Hitachi Construction Machinery named nine startup finalists from 139 applicants to pitch in Amsterdam on 3 December 2026. The three winners will exhibit at INTERMAT in Paris in April 2027 and enter collaboration talks on autonomous mining technology, site data, and equipment analytics.

stories.title: Türkiye expands rail network by 30% in past 25 years, plans to link more cities by high-speed rail
stories.summary: Türkiye expanded its railway network by around 30% over the past 25 years, with transport and infrastructure minister Abdulkadir Uraloglu stating the network grew from 10,948 kilometers in 2002 to 14,272 km this year. The ministry plans to add 18 more provinces to its high-speed rail roster by 2030, bringing the total to 32.

stories.title: NASA's X-59 Takes Off From Daytona International Airport
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic research jet took off from Daytona International Airport on November 11 and landed safely after weather blocked its planned display at Kennedy Space Center. The aircraft is designed to test quieter supersonic flight, with data to be delivered to the Federal Aviation Administration and international regulators to shape future rules.

stories.title: Tesla’s Texas Robotaxi Roster Now Has More Than 800 Cybercabs
stories.summary: Tesla's Texas Robotaxi roster now includes 822 Cybercabs and 734 Model Ys, totaling 1,556 vehicles. Cybercab rides are available in limited parts of Austin and Dallas, with the company announcing the vehicle's arrival in Dallas on November 19.

stories.title: Germany Uses Attack Drones to Strike Russian-Style Tanks in First Live-Fire Exercise
stories.summary: The German armed forces conducted their first live-fire exercise involving attack drones at the Rudninkai military training area in Lithuania, using kamikaze drones from Helsing and Stark to strike Leopard 2 tanks. The Bundeswehr plans to have its own drone regiment fully operational by 2029, with 350 personnel expected by 2027.

stories.title: India Prepares First Bullet Train Section for Trial Runs in May 2027
stories.summary: Indian Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that India will begin trial runs of its first bullet train in May 2027 on a 50-kilometre section between Surat and Bilimora. Signalling systems are expected to be ready by January 2027, with the first high-speed rail service targeted to begin operations in the final quarter of 2027.

stories.summary: First Hydrogen completed its unmanned ground vehicle and incorporated First Humanoid Corp. as a robotics subsidiary. The vehicle features morphing wheels and a modular payload system designed for defense, supply carrying, surveillance, and explosive deactivation.

stories.title: Lucid Advances Robotaxi Testing as Driverless Trials Near Launch
stories.summary: Uber and Nuro began testing driverless Lucid Gravity SUVs on public roads in the San Francisco Bay Area after Nuro received a California Department of Motor Vehicles permit in May 2026. The companies plan to offer driverless rides to employees ahead of a commercial robotaxi service launch in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Türkiye inducts Kizilelma unmanned fighter jet, but how does it compare with its rivals?
stories.summary: Türkiye delivered its first three Kizilelma unmanned combat jets to its armed forces, moving the Baykar-developed program from development into initial military service. The aircraft, which first flew in December 2022, has a maximum speed of Mach 0.9, a payload capacity of 1,500 kg, and a mission radius of 500 nautical miles.

stories.title: Neolix secures Singapore permit for public-road autonomous vehicle tests
stories.summary: Neolix obtained Singapore’s M1 permit for its Xolra 6 delivery vehicle, allowing public-road testing under the city-state’s staged autonomous-vehicle approval framework. The company will now prepare for trials and subsequent regulatory reviews, though it did not disclose the route, start date, or number of vehicles.

stories.title: NATO holds Baltic counter-drone drills with jets from four nations and Lithuania’s NASAMS
stories.summary: NATO’s Allied Air Command led counter-drone drills in the Baltic region from 17 to 19 November, coordinating fighter jets from Belgium, Finland, Italy, and Turkey with Lithuania’s NASAMS ground-based air defence system. The exercise used real drones to help air and ground crews refine shared procedures for responding to threats ranging from one-way attack drones to larger remotely piloted aircraft.

stories.title: EagleNXT books drone orders in seven countries, including in Africa
stories.summary: EagleNXT announced on 12 November 2026 that it sold drones to seven countries across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa in a single week. The company did not disclose the specific nations, customers, or order values, though it noted several additional orders are in process.

stories.title: Growth of the Autonomous Driving Services Market Driven by Increasing Applications and Rising Demand
stories.summary: The autonomous driving services market is projected to grow from $3.47 billion in 2025 to $13.03 billion by 2030, driven by the commercialization of robotaxi services and autonomous freight transport.

stories.title: Ports of Jersey Leads Work on Island's Counter-Drone Capability After Airport Drone Incidents
stories.summary: Ports of Jersey is leading ongoing work on the island's ability to respond to unauthorised drone activity, Home Affairs Minister Senator Helen Miles said. The update followed incidents at Jersey Airport that led to specialist assistance being sought from UK agencies.

stories.title: Volatus Aerospace signs contract for scheduled drone cargo service in North America
stories.summary: Volatus Aerospace signed a contract announced on 24 November to operate a scheduled drone cargo service for an unnamed North American logistics company. The agreement uses the Canary aircraft, which carries up to 5 kg over 30 km, to make up to six round trips per day between two customer locations.

stories.title: OneSky launches FIMS-connected airspace authorisation services in Australia
stories.summary: OneSky is now providing digital airspace services to eligible commercial drone operators in Australia through its connection to Airservices Australia’s Flight Information Management System (FIMS). The platform provides Automated Airspace Authorisations for eligible operations within three nautical miles of 28 civil controlled aerodromes.

stories.title: Boston Logan Airport Is Testing Self-Driving Wheelchairs and Cleaning Robots Ahead of 2027 Expansion
stories.summary: The Massachusetts Port Authority (Massport) is testing four autonomous cleaning robots from CenoBots in pre-security areas across all terminals at Boston Logan International Airport. Massport CEO Rich Davey stated the agency is seeking information from autonomous wheelchair manufacturers to expand that service next year, noting Logan's narrow corridors prevent the use of golf carts.

stories.title: Senate Panel Seeks Briefing on Autonomous Air Defense
stories.summary: The Senate Armed Services Committee's report accompanying the FY2027 National Defense Authorization Act requests a briefing from the Secretary of the Air Force by March 31, 2027. The briefing will cover autonomous and semi-autonomous air-to-air defense capabilities against drones and cruise missiles.

stories.title: Cheap Drones Give African Insurgents New Advantage As Militants Take War To The Skies
stories.summary: Armed insurgent groups in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger deployed inexpensive commercial drones to threaten military aircraft and infrastructure, according to a Reuters investigation. The Azawad Liberation Front launched the first reported drone-swarm attack in the Sahel in March, while al-Qaeda-linked JNIM carried out 187 drone attacks between 2023 and mid-November 2026.

stories.title: Russia issued flight ban ahead of Romanian F-16 strike on Black Sea drone
stories.summary: Former Romanian Defense Minister Radu Miruță revealed that Romanian Air Force F-16s engaged an explosive-laden maritime drone near the Neptun Deep offshore gas project on August 20, 2026, despite a Russian flight ban announced shortly after the order to engage. Miruță stated the operation pushed legal boundaries outside Romania’s territorial waters and risked a military response from Moscow, which did not occur.

stories.title: Florida TODAY: Amazon drone delivery, Black Friday, Epic Universe
stories.summary: Amazon drones are already delivering packages in the Tampa area, with more Florida cities on the horizon.

stories.title: Path2 develops online robot cell builder to make automation more accessible
stories.summary: UK robotics software startup Path2 is developing a browser-based robot cell design and programming platform to help smaller manufacturers automate production without substantial systems integration budgets. The platform currently supports 20 Kuka robot models with payload capacities ranging from 20 to 800 kg, with support for ABB, Fanuc, Universal Robots and other major robot manufacturers planned. Path2 plans to charge £495 for an individual robot cell design package, while a subscription costing £99 per month will provide access to unlimited cell design packages.

stories.title: AI Software Aims to Keep Military Drones on Course Through Jamming
stories.summary: SPARC AI launched its Overwatch Positioning Network in August 2026, a software service that helps military drones determine location without GPS by processing existing flight telemetry. The company states the system can reduce positioning errors to approximately 3 or 4 meters, though the U.S. military has not independently verified these figures or announced a contract.

stories.title: ‘Black day for rail’: inside Germany’s 2027 transport budget
XPENG targets January 2027 for mass production of its IRON humanoid robot
stories.summary: XPENG plans to begin hardware mass production of its IRON humanoid robot in January 2027, utilizing a dedicated automated production line and a 50,000 m² robot data facility. Training within XPENG’s retail stores is scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027, with an official launch targeted for the second quarter.

also.title: XPeng plans January production of IRON humanoid robot, with showroom deployment to follow

stories.title: Jupiter Wagons eyes ₹3,000-4,000 crore annual revenue from passenger rail business in 4-5 years
stories.summary: Jupiter Wagons expects its passenger railway business to generate annual revenue of ₹3,000-4,000 crore over the next four to five years, according to Managing Director Vivek Lohia. The company plans to invest around ₹1,000 crore over the next three years to support expansion, with manufacturing of propulsion systems expected to start as early as next year following a technology transfer from Woojin Industrial Systems.

stories.title: Pentagon’s bomber UAV trials test how fast industry can respond
stories.summary: The Pentagon’s Drone Dominance Program held its Gauntlet 2.5 competition on 13 November 2026 at Camp Grayling, Michigan, where eight suppliers tested reusable bomber uncrewed aerial vehicles. US manufacturer Swarm Defense developed a prototype platform in two-and-a-half weeks for what the program described as its most demanding and expedited testing to date.

also.title: Pentagon Tests Reusable Bomber Drones in Michigan

stories.title: EU plans rapid response force, counter-drone measures to secure eastern borders
stories.summary: European Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration Magnus Brunner told the European Parliament on Tuesday that the EU is preparing to strengthen security along its eastern borders through a proposed rapid response force, expanded counter-drone capabilities and tighter visa restrictions.

stories.title: Czech jet engine maker eyes growing role as US supplier in drones, missiles
stories.summary: Czech jet engine maker PBS Aerospace aims to double its U.S. production capacity, planning to allocate around $100 million to boost output at its Roswell, Georgia facility. The company targets annual production of 10,000 to 20,000 engines over the next three years, with up to 5,000 engines produced in America next year, to meet rising demand for compact propulsion systems in drones and cruise missiles.

also.title: PBS Aerospace plans to double U.S. production capacity as demand for drone and missile engines rises -

stories.title: XCMG, EACON Expand Autonomous Mining Truck Partnership
stories.summary: XCMG Group and EACON Group signed a strategic cooperation agreement at bauma CHINA 2026 to deepen their work on autonomous mining trucks. The deal follows an August 2026 memorandum of understanding between XCMG Australia and EACON Australia.

stories.title: He Xiaopeng at XPENG Tech Day: Manned eVTOL TC Certification Enters Final Stage, A868 Completes Tilt-Transition Test Flight-Internet Info Agency
stories.summary: He Xiaopeng announced at XPENG Tech Day on November 25, 2026, that the world's first manned eVTOL type certificate (TC) certification has entered its final stage. The A868 electric flying car completed tilt transition flight tests, and XPENG AEROHT is jointly building the world's first low-altitude regulatory sandbox for flying cars with the UAE.

Ukraine’s Heavy VATAG Ground Drone Proves It Can Tow 12 Tons in Latest Trials
stories.summary: Ukraine’s heavy unmanned ground vehicle VATAG demonstrated its ability to carry payloads of up to two metric tons and tow loads weighing up to 12 metric tons during testing. Developed by Ground Systems, the platform features a hybrid powertrain and supports both remotely controlled and autonomous driving modes.

stories.title: Armenia’s Zeel AI partners Nigeria’s Arridex on local drone production
stories.summary: Armenian defence technology company Zeel AI entered a strategic partnership with Nigerian industrial group Arridex at the Africa International Defence Exhibition (AFRIDEX) 2026 in Lagos. Under the arrangement, Zeel AI’s autonomous systems and artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities join the Arridex portfolio, with production to take place in Nigeria.

stories.title: Turkey’s New High-Speed Railway Line on the China–European Union Route
stories.summary: Turkey opened the first section of a high-speed rail line built by a consortium led by Webuild, connecting the Çerkezköy logistics hub to the town of Kapıkule on the border with Bulgaria. The 153-kilometre line is the longest section of the Halkalı-Kapıkule railway, which will reach a total length of 229 kilometres once the final section is finished.

Hyundai Rotem Company Expands from Unmanned Vehicles to Counter-Drone Systems
stories.summary: Hyundai Rotem Company is developing a layered counter-drone defense system with an unmanned turret that uses artificial intelligence (AI)-based detection and identification technology to respond to drone threats. The company is considering ways to apply the system to tanks, armored vehicles, and unmanned vehicles.

stories.title: KLN Logistics and Hai Robotics collaborate on smart warehousing solutions
stories.summary: KLN Logistics Group Limited announced a partnership with Hai Robotics to advance smart warehousing solutions, building on three projects deployed in Shenzhen, Jiaxing, and the Middle East. The collaboration aims to enhance operational efficiency and resilience for international customers by combining KLN’s supply chain knowledge with Hai Robotics’ automation capabilities.

also.title: KLN, Hai Robotics partner on warehouse automation

stories.title: Siemens advances physical AI and autonomous production technologies
stories.summary: Siemens is expanding its industrial automation portfolio with artificial intelligence technologies designed to enable autonomous production, from AI-powered planning and engineering systems to physical AI applications on factory floors.

also.title: Siemens Expands Industrial AI Across Planning and Robot Unpacking

stories.title: MTA gets access to Amtrak’s Penn Station design, LIRR lease stays intact
stories.summary: The Metropolitan Transportation Authority and Amtrak signed an information-sharing agreement on November 24, granting the MTA access to design documents for the Penn Station overhaul. The deal leaves the MTA's existing lease unchanged and does not commit the agency to backing the project, which Amtrak estimates will cost $7 billion to $8 billion.

stories.title: Ati Robotics turns to engineering AI to validate autonomous robot hardware
stories.summary: Ati Robotics adopted SimScale's AI-native simulation platform to validate the structural and mechanical performance of its Sherpa autonomous mobile robot. The US-headquartered company uses the cloud-based tool to evaluate vehicle designs against load, speed, and reliability requirements for continuous factory-floor operation, supporting development teams in the US and India.

stories.title: MTR bags three ICT awards for AI and drone railway innovations
stories.summary: MTR Corporation received three awards at the Hong Kong ICT Awards 2026 for its NEX-T drone tunnel inspection system and Smart Light Rail 2.0 platform. NEX-T won the Gold award and Smart Mobility Grand Award, while Smart Light Rail 2.0 took the Silver award in the Smart Mobility category.

stories.title: Germany Plans to Arm Its First-Ever Drone Regiment With Ukrainian Drones and Flamingo Missiles
stories.summary: Germany plans to establish its first dedicated drone regiment in 2027 with approximately 350 soldiers, expanding to around 600 by 2029. The unit will incorporate Ukrainian-made reconnaissance drones, ground robotic systems, and Flamingo cruise missiles capable of striking targets more than 2,000 kilometers away, with procurement costs estimated at €150 million.

also.title: Germany's first-ever drone regiment will be armed with Ukrainian drones

stories.title: Iran Claims Second US MQ-9 Drone Shot Down Near Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's military claimed it shot down a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz, stating its air defense systems targeted and destroyed the aircraft. US defense officials have not issued an official response or independently confirmed the incident, leaving the drone's mission and exact location unclear.

stories.title: Overnight Russian drone assault hits 18 sites across Ukraine, kills one man
stories.summary: Russian forces launched 112 drones from multiple locations inside Russia and occupied territories, striking 18 sites in Ukraine on Nov. 25. The attack killed one man in Bila Tserkva and damaged facilities belonging to Nova Poshta and Epitsentr, while Ukrainian air defense units shot down or suppressed 88 drones.

stories.title: Bentic prepares for US expansion as physical AI robot installations approach 100
stories.summary: Bentic, a Munich-based company, is preparing to enter the US market with technology that enables robots to handle deformable materials such as textiles, cables, carbon fiber and food. The company expects to deliver its first systems in the United States before the end of 2026.

stories.title: Supersonic Jet Aircraft Market Outlook 2026: Aircraft Innovation, Key Players and Strategic Growth Opportuniti
stories.summary: The global Supersonic Jet Aircraft market was valued at US$ 61800 million in 2025 and is anticipated to reach US$ 91173 million by 2032, witnessing a CAGR of 5.4% during the forecast period 2026-2032.

stories.title: Short-range radar advances counter-drone protection
stories.summary: Hanwha Systems will supply short-range active electronically scanned array radar units to US defence technology company Rebellion Industries for a pilot programme, with deliveries expected by early 2027. The integrated system, which combines the radar with Rebellion’s Sensor OS software, is intended for military and civilian applications including protection around data centres, logistics facilities, refineries, and sports venues.

stories.title: Russia Unveils Drone Detector Capable of Capturing UAV Video from 1km
stories.summary: Russia's Drone Defense company unveiled Kashchey, a portable drone detector that captures video feeds from compatible FPV drones at distances of up to 1,000 meters. The device was presented at the 30th International Exhibition of Means of State Security Provision (INTERPOLITEX), and the company plans to manufacture approximately 50 units by the end of November and increase production to 600 units by the end of December.

stories.title: Reliability emerges as the next big challenge for robotics
stories.summary: Engineering technology company HBK published an article arguing that ensuring robots operate reliably over extended periods is becoming one of the industry’s biggest challenges. The company states that commercial success depends on machines performing tasks consistently, safely, and predictably over potentially millions of operating cycles, noting that reliability is increasingly becoming a competitive differentiator.

stories.title: Libyan naval officers die following Ukrainian drone attack, and other Mideast news
stories.summary: Two Libyan naval officers died following a Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian warship in Libya, an event that opened a new theater in the conflict thousands of miles from the front lines of the Russia-Ukraine war.

stories.title: XPENG Shows Off AI-Powered EV Factory As China’s Robotaxis Gear Up For Global Expansion
stories.summary: XPENG showcased its AI-powered Guangzhou factory and YOYO Robotaxi ahead of its eighth annual AI Day on Wednesday. The company received approval for Level 4 autonomous vehicle demonstration operations in Guangzhou and is holding advanced discussions with European mobility platforms to expand its Robotaxi service overseas.

stories.title: Karnataka CM Shivakumar Eyes Huge Bullet Train Plan After Ride
stories.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar expressed interest in bringing bullet train technology to the state after riding Japan’s Shinkansen between Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka. He praised the network’s punctuality and cleanliness but has not announced a specific route, project proposal, investment plan, or implementation timeline.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Syzran and Kuibyshev Oil Refineries in Russia’s Samara Region
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck the Syzran and Kuibyshev oil refineries in Russia’s Samara Region on the night of November 25, causing fires at both facilities. The Exilenova+ monitoring channel reported the attack, while local residents shared footage of the large fires.

stories.title: Turaç brings Drone Kalkanı counter-drone turret to Africa at BAMEX
stories.summary: Turkish ammunition maker Turaç displayed its Drone Kalkanı counter-drone turret at the Bamako Defence Exhibition (BAMEX) 2026 in Mali from 9 to 13 November. The system, which is 95 per cent complete, uses two 12-gauge shotguns to engage drones at close range and can be mounted on various vehicles or fixed sites.

stories.title: This Analyst Sees $4 Billion in Robotaxi Revenue for Tesla, Initiates Coverage With 25% Upside
stories.summary: Seaport Global Securities initiated coverage of Tesla Inc. with a $475 price target, projecting the Robotaxi business could reach an annual recurring revenue of $3 to $4 billion by the end of next year. The firm stated that the Robotaxi reflects a trillion-dollar opportunity and that it was the only opportunity that would justify the company’s valuation.
